Has a case that View-only cannot create a workload view
Checks API enforcement on the real save endpoint PUT /reports/custom-workload
Includes cross-level isolation (project-only vs global-only grants)
Notes that delete has no documented API and must be captured from the UI
Warns that checkbox state must be read from the ruc-checkbox wrapper (rc-checked)
Uses the real profile checkbox keys input_profile_checkbox_<id>_workloadreport_*
Plans cleanup/restore of test data (QA-WL- prefix or explicit teardown)
